convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <tmp.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 17 frames hash-identical).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, per-state contract roots (#securitiesPricesCard / .sp-md / .sp-rowmenu), Chromium via playwright 1.58.x headless, deviceScaleFactor 2. Capture protocol (CAPTURE v2.1, drive.js): Google Fonts origins blocked + @font-face injection serving Heebo/Noto Serif from the SAME TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/); --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning; animations/transitions frozen; fresh context per state (storage-seeded list resets); pointer parked (re-hover replayed for scrubber-pinned); iterative integer-pixel-grid snap on the root (Chromium LayoutUnit quantizes to 1/64px — one pass is not enough for body-mounted popovers); geometry-quiescence wait; double-screenshot self-consistency gate.
convergence.iterationNotes: It1 authoring from extracted geometry (DOM->paint-ops walker: boxes, per-side borders, per-line text with measured baselines, SVG via getScreenCTM transforms): all 17 states 1.4-2.6%, cause: pen text-box model. It2 baseline probe model (pen renders baseline at ~0.75em Heebo / ~0.82em Noto Serif from node y, measured per family x weight x 15 sizes): 15/17 in 1.0-1.6%, 2 pass. It3 per-bucket dy corrections measured by SAD alignment over sampled text crops (dx=0 everywhere; dy +0.5..2px growing with size) + U+22EE kebab vectorized to dots (Heebo owns no vertical-ellipsis glyph; Chromium and pen fall back to different faces — glyph captured as canvas-ink-measured vector circles): 16/17 pass. It4 rounded corners: pen renders rectangle cornerRadius as a SQUIRCLE vs CSS circular arcs — radius >= 9 (popover 10, dialog 12, capsule pills) re-emitted as explicit circular-arc paths (radius positional geometry; radius <= 8 keeps token-bound rectangles, deviation sub-AA) + iterative root snap: 17/17 pass, worst 0.915%. It5 text-transform defect found by crop inspection (extractor carried DOM text, not rendered uppercase headers) fixed: 17/17 pass, worst 0.825%, most states 0.4-0.5%. Baseline/corner probes ran as tooling measurement outside the fix-round budget (GC-004 convention).

narrow tier: 440px content frame, table bleeds to 480px full-bleed (rule 11, narrow-stacked)

normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: Prototype is Heebo-native (--font-ui Heebo-first, --font-serif Noto Serif). Swap reduces to (a) forcing --font-ui onto UA-default control surfaces (recorded find-replace) and (b) serving Heebo + Noto Serif from the SAME repo TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/), Google Fonts blocked at capture.
normalizationRecipe.notes: Identity injections are recorded because the injection IS the reconciliation record. The prototype re-declares its token set at THREE scopes (:root ~L995 + r65 re-pin ~L3939; #appMain,.sp-md-backdrop ~L1040; #cs-watchlist,#wlHeadSlot ~L2722 and #appMain #cs-watchlist,... ~L3187) — the override style block carries all scopes and sits last in the document. Dark :root/[data-theme] blocks left untouched — dark is uncontracted (design-rules rule 36); every token bound here carries its dark value in the library/local definitions. Squircle note for the re-export lab: rounded rects with radius >= 9 are authored as circular-arc PATH nodes because pen's rectangle cornerRadius renders as a squircle (probe-verified) — do not "simplify" them back to rectangles.
